title: A centred prime-scale chirp keeps both corners positive, with a row sum above 1 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, and the centred chirp `t_i=i-9/2`, both bandwidth-2 Schur directions between vertices 1 and 8 stay positive. The forward corner lies strictly between `1/10^50` and `1/10^49`. The reverse corner lies strictly between `1/10^222` and `1/10^221`. The half-bandwidth is 3.
- The centred entry from vertex 0 to vertex 1 equals `exp(63 pi/1444)` and is strictly greater than 1. The distance-2 entry in that row is positive and there is no Schur fill, so the off-diagonal row sum exceeds 1. Wider bandwidths keep this same entry.
- At these parameters the displayed expression `exp(-2 a theta)+5 exp(-2 a)` is strictly less than 1. This section sits outside the hypothesis `||E||_infinity<1` of the narrow Neumann bound. No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged.
